title: Mighty Silverfist Boss Guide: Pillar Slam, Roll and the Book of Specialisation
summary: Path of Exile 2 Act 3 Jungle Ruins optional boss guide: Pillar Slam, Pillar Slash, Spin Attack, Commando Roll, and the Book of Specialisation for +2 Weapon Set Passive Points.
description: Find and beat Mighty Silverfist in the Jungle Ruins (Act 3). Attack tells, the hidden-boss location, and how the Book of Specialisation grants +2 Weapon Set Passive Points.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: Mighty Silverfist is a hidden optional boss in the Act 3 Jungle Ruins whose kill drops the Book of Specialisation, granting +2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points — not normal Passive Points.
calloutDetail: He is easy to miss: no quest marker, procedurally placed at the Temple Ruins; press Tab to enlarge the minimap and spot the 'Temple Ruins' label.
Stay behind him — most hits are forward shockwaves; the Commando Roll has almost no tell.
The Book drops on the ground; pick it up AND right-click it. It grants Weapon Set Passive Points, shown in the Weapon Set node, not your main pool.

items.question: Where is Mighty Silverfist in the Jungle Ruins?
answer: From Ziggurat Encampment enter the Jungle Ruins; he spawns at the Temple Ruins landmark, usually near the center or a map edge. There is no quest marker — look for the 'Temple Ruins' label on the enlarged minimap.

items.question: Why is he so easy to miss?
answer: He is an optional boss off the critical path with no marker; maps are procedurally generated. Players rushing Act 3 skip him.

items.question: Why didn't I get Passive Points?
answer: The Book of Specialisation drops on the ground and must be picked up AND right-clicked. The +2 are Weapon Set Passive Points (Weapon Set node), not your normal Passive Point total.

items.question: Is the Commando Roll a one-shot?
answer: No. It was reduced in damage twice (0.1.1 and 0.2.0). It is still fast and low-tell, but do not use old launch-era one-shot numbers.

steps.label: Enter the Jungle Ruins
body: From Ziggurat Encampment, go into the Act 3 Jungle Ruins.

steps.label: Find Temple Ruins
body: Look for the 'Temple Ruins' landmark (enlarge the minimap with Tab). It is near the center or a zone edge.

steps.label: Trigger the fight
body: Approach the Temple Ruins to spawn Mighty Silverfist.

sections.title: Encounter Overview
paragraphs: Mighty Silverfist is a slow, heavily telegraphed optional boss built around a giant pillar. All four of his attacks deal Physical damage, and staying behind him is the safest position because most hits are forward shockwaves.
He is not the hardest boss, but he can one-shot under-geared builds with the Pillar Slam. Below about half HP his Commando Roll appears and his combos tighten.
bullets: All Physical damage — elemental / Fire reportedly shreds him.
Stay behind him; front shocks are the danger.
The Book of Specialisation is the point of the fight.

sections.title: Arena and Hidden Location
paragraphs: The fight takes place at the Temple Ruins, a small open area. The bigger challenge is finding him: the Jungle Ruins are procedurally generated, he has no quest marker, and the only hint is the 'Temple Ruins' text label.
Clear the trash mobs around the Temple Ruins first — distractions are deadly against a boss that can one-shot. A checkpoint is usually nearby for recovery.
bullets: No quest marker; look for 'Temple Ruins' on the map.
Press Tab to enlarge the minimap.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Continuous Fight (Escalating)
notes: No formal phase split; below ~50% HP the Commando Roll intensifies and combos tighten.

attacks.name: Pillar Slam
telegraph: Raises the pillar overhead and slams a target location.
responses: Dodge sideways or circle behind as he lifts.
notes: Leaves forward ground shockwaves; can one-shot squishy builds.

attacks.name: Pillar Slash
telegraph: Swings the pillar in front of him.
responses: Move sideways out of the frontal arc, then watch for the follow-up slam.

attacks.name: Spin Attack
telegraph: Spins multiple times, then a heavy finishing hit.
responses: Retreat to max distance / get behind; do not attack during the spin.

attacks.name: Commando Roll
telegraph: Almost no tell — leaps and rolls forward.
responses: Dodge-roll away / under; ranged can see it coming.
notes: Damage reduced twice (0.1.1, 0.2.0); still fast and low-tell.

sections.title: Reward Claim Flow — Book of Specialisation to +2 Weapon Set Passives
paragraphs: Kill Mighty Silverfist; the Book of Specialisation drops on the ground (guaranteed on first kill). Pick it up — dying before grabbing it can lose it.
Right-click the Book in inventory. It grants +2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points, allocated in the Weapon Set node of the passive tree — not your normal Passive Point pool.
bullets: Kill Silverfist -> Book drops on ground.
Right-click the Book -> +2 Weapon Set Passive Points.
One-time; shown in the Weapon Set node.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: Silverfist rewards patience: bait a slam or slash, punish the recovery, then reset. Treat it like a turn-based loop — attack, dodge, attack.
Melee wants to stay behind him to avoid the forward shockwaves; ranged can kite but must respect the Commando Roll's forward lunge. Physical mitigation is the priority, not DPS.
bullets: Melee: stay behind, punish after slams.
Ranged: kite, respect the Roll lunge.

entries.question: Silverfist dropped the Book but it didn't reach inventory
summary: A player killed him, died before grabbing the Book, and it was gone on respawn; a later poster found it in a collapsed 'extra 20' inventory tab.
editorialAnalysis: The Book drops on the ground and can sit in a hidden inventory tab. It must be picked up and right-clicked.
officialAnswer: Pick up the Book of Specialisation and right-click it for +2 Weapon Set Passive Points.

entries.question: Weapon set passive points not dropping
summary: Players on 0.4 / PS5 report the Book 'yet to drop'; usually user error — never picked up or never right-clicked.
editorialAnalysis: The +2 are Weapon Set Passive Points in the Weapon Set node, not the normal Passive Point total. Confusion is common.
officialAnswer: The Book grants +2 Weapon Set Passive Points, allocated in the passive tree Weapon Set node.

directAnswer: He spawns at the Temple Ruins in the Jungle Ruins with no marker. Enlarge the minimap (Tab) and look for the 'Temple Ruins' label; it is usually near the center or a zone edge.
The Book drops on the ground and must be picked up AND right-clicked. The +2 are Weapon Set Passive Points in the Weapon Set node, not your normal pool.
It has almost no tell. Dodge-roll away or under it; it was reduced in damage twice, but still fast. Do not use old launch-era damage numbers.
